pull.title: policy: Document rounding behavior of feerate fee getters
pull.body:
Now that the impl moved into the C++ file in 38ece2a9c853ae3db9afb5215611c3e23e40461f, it could make sense to document the rounding behavior in the header file doxygen comment.

Also, drop the "special case", which seems more confusing than helpful. (It is only a special case for negative feerates, which are mostly irrelevant and only possible with manual fee prioritization deltas)
